name: smwsprites-rounding-boo
title: Rounding Boo
description:
This little ghost moves back and forth, going behind the foreground and coming back with each turn. Extra Byte 1 determines its initial facing direction (left or right), and Extra Byte 2 determines if it'll start in front of or behind the foreground.

Includes max speed defines, tilemap defines, and a define for amount of frames before slowing down and turning around.
